verdict.rationale: MailerLite is an email-marketing SaaS. It acts as a tool provider to AI assistants (it ships an MCP integration for Claude), not as an AI host that consumes other MCP servers' tools, so the MCP-client role is a different product role. The evidence describes only server-side MCP connectivity, which does not count toward this client-side story, and nothing shows MailerLite plugging in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
